cards.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

Sword of Truth and Justice.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Sword of Body and Mind. +2/+2, protection from white and blue; on a hit a +1/+1 counter and proliferate. The fourth Sword if one underperforms.

Sword of Sinew and Steel.text: +2/+2, protection from black and red; on a hit destroy a planeswalker and an artifact. Protection from red blanks most burn aimed at the body.

Sword of Hearth and Home.text: +2/+2, protection from green and white; on a hit blink a creature you own (resets the body's damage) and ramp a basic.

Maul of the Skyclaves.text: CUT 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Chainsaw. IN 2026-11-11 for Ferocification. Attaches on entry: +2/+2, flying, first strike. Strong on any body; the Equipment slots went to the Swords.

Bladehold War-Whip.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Gods Willing. A 2/2 Rebel on entry; equip costs {1} less and equipped creatures have double strike. Cheaper equips for three Swords.

Kaldra Compleat.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Crackling Cyclops. 7 mana: a 5/5 germ with indestructible, haste, first strike, trample; exiles what it hits. Top-end if the curve has room.

Lightning Bolt.text: 1-mana 3 damage; the first removal back if interaction is short.

Abrade.text: OWNED. 3 damage to a creature or destroy an artifact.

Chaos Warp.text: Shuffles any permanent away; a red answer to enchantments and planeswalkers.

Fateful Absence.text: 2-mana instant: destroy a creature or planeswalker; they get a Clue.

Collective Inferno.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Lightning Greaves. OWNED. Doubles the damage of sources of a chosen type you control: a double-damage Voltron body and doubled Self-Destruct.

Aurelia, Exemplar of Justice.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Get Lost. The alternative commander: +2/+0, trample and vigilance on one creature every combat, and a flier. Pure Voltron, but no card flow.

Unleash Fury.text: Cut in the draft for Monastery Mentor: doubles power, overlapping Bulk Up.

Return the Favor.text: Cut in the draft for Fiery Confluence: a copy/redirect trick, weaker at 100 cards.

Sigarda's Aid.text: CUT 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Bre of Clan Stoutarm. IN 2026-11-11 for Tome of Legends. Cut in the draft for Tome of Legends: flash Equipment and auto-attach; low power on its own.

Speedball, New Warrior.text: ILLEGAL under Feather: the {W/U} hybrid puts blue in its colour identity. Boros Reckoner took the slot (itself cut 2026-11-11 for Raph & Leo).

Sram, Senior Edificer.text: Draws on Equipment and Aura casts (about nine here); thin for a slot.

Clash of Titans.text: 5-mana fight Feather returns; The Last Agni Kai does it for 2.

Ephemerate.text: OWNED. Feather returns it, but the blink resets the body's counters and Equipment fall off.

Rabid Gnaw.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Path to Exile. OWNED. Your creature gets +1/+0, then deals damage equal to its power to a creature you don't control: a 2-mana bite Feather returns every end step, so removal every turn off the deck's one big body.

Giantfall.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Light Up the Stage. OWNED. Your creature deals damage equal to its power to their creature, or destroy an artifact. Feather returns the bite mode (it targets your creature); a second repeatable removal spell.

Fall of the Hammer.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Swords to Plowshares. CRAFT (C). Your creature deals damage equal to its power to another creature: the third repeatable bite.

Temur Battle Rage.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Choreographed Sparks. CRAFT (C). Double strike, plus trample with a 4-power creature out (nearly always here). Feather returns it, so the body swings with double strike and trample every turn.

Might of the Meek.text: OWNED. {R}: trample and draw a card; Feather makes it a 1-mana draw every turn. Not taken in round 1; first cantrip back if card flow is short.

Rogue's Passage.text: IN 2026-11-11 for a Mountain. OWNED. A land: {4},{T}: target creature can't be blocked. The Voltron finisher that costs no spell slot.

Laelia, the Blade Reforged.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Demonic Ruckus. OWNED. Haste; each attack exiles the top card to play this turn, and she grows whenever cards are exiled from your library or graveyard. A body that draws and gets bigger; strong carrier for the Swords.

Akiri, Fearless Voyager.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Energybending. CRAFT (R). Draw a card whenever you attack with an equipped creature; {W}: move an Equipment to make a creature indestructible. Card flow from the Equipment package.

Tenth District Legionnaire.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Team Tactics. CRAFT (U). A 2-mana haste body that gets a +1/+1 counter and scry 1 for every spell that targets it; Feather's tricks hit it every turn. SPICE: the body you build up.

Showdown of the Skalds.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Loran's Escape. CRAFT (R). Saga: exile the top four and play them until chapter III; chapters II and III put a +1/+1 counter on a creature whenever you cast a spell. Card advantage the deck lacks.

Blazing Crescendo.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Heroic Reinforcements. OWNED. +3/+1 and exile the top card to play through next turn; returned by Feather, an impulse draw every turn.

Ancestors' Aid.text: OWNED. +2/+0 and first strike plus a Treasure; returned by Feather, a Treasure every turn (ramp into Embercleave and Aurelia, the Warleader).

Dual-Sun Technique.text: OWNED. Double strike, and a card if the creature has a +1/+1 counter (Tenth District Legionnaire, Laelia, Elspeth Resplendent and The Wandering Emperor all put counters on now). Overlaps the deck's other double strike.

Panther Pounce.text: OWNED. {W}: +1/+0, flying, untap, and you investigate. A 1-mana Clue every turn with Feather.

Reyav, Master Smith.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Speed, Young Avenger. CRAFT (U). Equipped or enchanted attackers gain double strike: every Sword trigger twice. Overlaps the double-strike tricks.

Bruenor Battlehammer.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Reckless Impulse. CRAFT (U). +2/+0 per Equipment on each creature and the first equip each turn is free: moves three Swords around without mana.

Zada, Hedron Grinder.text: IN 2026-11-11 for War Machine, Legacy of Iron. CRAFT (R). A spell that targets only Zada is copied for each other creature you control: Bulk Up, Legion Leadership or Temur Battle Rage on Zada hits the whole team, and Feather returns the original. Aim bites (Rabid Gnaw, Fall of the Hammer) elsewhere, since every copy hits the same target. Bodies to copy onto: Monastery Mentor Monks, Wandering Emperor Samurai.

Champion of the Flame.text: CUT 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Sif's Spearmaster. IN 2026-11-11 for Unexpected Windfall. CRAFT (U). SPICE: trample, +2/+2 per Aura and Equipment attached. A cheap body that gets enormous under two Swords.

Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflectio.text: CRAFT (R). A Goblin that makes Treasure, a rummage chapter, then a copy machine (copy Laelia or Tenth District Legionnaire, both in the deck now). Value, but not a Feather card.

Castle Embereth.text: CRAFT (R). A Mountain-gated untapped land that pumps the team +1/+0. Replaces a basic at no spell cost.

Castle Ardenvale.text: CRAFT (R). A Plains-gated land that makes 1/1s late. Replaces a basic.

Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire.text: CRAFT (R). A Plains that can channel for 4 damage to an attacker or blocker. Replaces a basic.

Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance.text: CRAFT (R). A Mountain that can channel for two hasty 1/1s. Replaces a basic.

Spectacular Tactics.text: OWNED. A +1/+1 counter and hexproof (Feather returns that mode), or destroy a creature with power 4+ (that mode targets theirs, so it is not returned).

Feat of Resistance.text: CRAFT (C). A +1/+1 counter and protection from a colour; returned each turn.

Kaya's Onslaught.text: CRAFT (U). +1/+1 and double strike; foretell for {W}. Left out 2026-11-11: double strike does not stack, and Temur Battle Rage, Reyav, Embercleave, Boros Charm and Swiftblade already give it.

Two-Handed Axe.text: OWNED. SPICE: the Adventure half is a double-strike instant that targets your creature, so Feather can return it to hand instead of sending it on an adventure; or cast the Equipment that doubles power on attack.

Swift Kick.text: CRAFT (C). A 4-mana fight Feather returns; Rabid Gnaw, Giantfall and Fall of the Hammer (all in now) do it for 2.

Brimaz, King of Oreskos.text: OWNED. A strong 3-drop, but its tokens come from attacking and blocking, not from the deck's tricks.

Phalanx Leader.text: CRAFT (U). Heroic: a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control per spell that targets it; spells that only need 'a creature' (Seize the Day's untap) can go to it, Feather returns them, so the team grows every turn. Re-graded 2026-11-11 on the owner's mark.

Integrity // Intervention.text: CRAFT (U). Integrity (+2/+2 for one hybrid mana) returns with Feather; Intervention is 3 damage and 3 life. Fine, unexceptional.

The Wandering Emperor.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Untimely Malfunction. OWNED. PLANESWALKER. Flash, and the turn she enters her abilities work at instant speed. +1: a +1/+1 counter and first strike on your creature (grows the body every turn); −1: a 2/2 vigilance Samurai (a body for Zada); −2: exile a tapped creature. Growth, protection-by-ambush and removal in one card.

Elspeth Resplendent.text: IN 2026-11-11 for Shelter. OWNED. PLANESWALKER. +1: a +1/+1 counter AND a flying, first strike, lifelink or vigilance COUNTER on your creature, so the body keeps the keyword for good; −3: put a 3-or-less permanent from the top seven onto the battlefield with a shield counter (Stoneforge, Jor Kadeen, Tenth District Legionnaire, a Sword).

Basri Ket.text: CRAFT (M). PLANESWALKER, 3 mana. +1: a +1/+1 counter and indestructible until end of turn on the body every turn; −2: attacking makes Soldier tokens (bodies for Zada, in now). Optional add for Titan's Strength, not applied.

Ajani, Caller of the Pride.text: OWNED. PLANESWALKER, 3 mana. +1: a +1/+1 counter on a creature; −3: flying and double strike for the turn, a finisher on the big body.

Gideon Blackblade.text: OWNED. PLANESWALKER, 3 mana. A 4/4 indestructible attacker on your turn; +1: another creature gains vigilance, lifelink or indestructible. Protection rather than growth.

Nahiri, Heir of the Ancients.text: CRAFT (M). PLANESWALKER. +1: a 1/1 Kor Warrior and attach an Equipment to it; −2: find an Equipment in the top six. Supports the Equipment build; no direct pump.

Bre of Clan Stoutarm.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Sigarda's Aid. OWNED. {1}{W},{T}: your big creature gains flying and lifelink; at end step, if you gained life, exile to a nonland card and cast it FREE if its MV is at most the life gained. A lifelinking Voltron body gains 8+ a turn, so this is a free spell every turn: card advantage, the short axis (rule 3).

The Akroan War.text: Saga: steal their best creature, force their team to attack into your board, then every tapped creature hurts itself. Interaction that also adds a body (rule 2 on the stolen creature).

Anax, Hardened in the Forge.text: Power equals devotion to red and makes tokens on deaths: neither grows the one body (rule 2).

Huatli, Warrior Poet.text: PLANESWALKER. +2 gains life equal to your greatest power (huge with the Voltron body, and it turns on Bre), 0 makes a 3/3 trampler, −X splits damage and stops blockers. 5 mana (rule 6).

Team Tactics.text: RE-READ 2026-11-11: double strike, plus trample if you tap creatures with total power 1+ (teamwork). It targets a creature, so Feather returns it every turn: a second Temur Battle Rage. Both halves are covered (Temur Battle Rage, Embercleave, Reyav for double strike; Shadowspear, Kaldra, Swiftblade, Embercleave for trample), so it is backup rather than a slot-earner.

Dreadhorde Arcanist.text: Recasts an instant or sorcery from the graveyard on attack, but Feather already returns the targeting ones to hand; only the one-shots (Akroma's Will, Fiery Confluence) reach the yard.

Furious Rise.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Defiant Strike. End step: if you control a creature with power 4+ (nearly always here), exile the top card and play it until the next one. A 3-mana repeatable card every turn: card advantage, the short axis (rule 3).

Amplifire.text: Random size from the next creature in the library; not a body you build on.

Molten Monstrosity.text: Costs X less where X is your greatest power: a 5/5 trampler for 2-4 mana once the body is big. A body, not an engine.

Dragonborn Immolator.text: CARRIER INSURANCE: if it is the built-up body and dies (removal, Fling, Self-Destruct), its full power goes perpetually onto the next creature spell, Feather's recast included, so removal on the body no longer resets the game. Self-Destruct on it is X damage plus +X perpetual. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Zarda, the Power Princess.text: Other Heroes get exalted (attacking alone grows the attacker); only a few Heroes here (The Sentry, Luke Cage, Iron Fist). Fits Team Avatar's attack-alone line, thin elsewhere.

Priest of Possibility.text: Alchemy: perpetual keywords seen in the top seven. A random 2-drop body.

Firebending Student.text: OWNED. Prowess grows it on every Feather spell, and firebending adds R equal to its power on attack: as the carrier, mana for Lunar Frenzy, Response or Temur Battle Rage mid-combat. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Guardian Scalelord.text: Backup gives the BIG BODY 'when it attacks, return a nonland permanent card with MV up to its power from your graveyard' for the turn, and every extra combat is another return; Scalelord keeps it after as a 3/4 flier. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Hamletback Goliath.text: 7 mana; grows off other creatures entering, which this deck makes few of.

Bionic Blow.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Lightning Helix. Sorcery {X}{R}{R}: your creature gets +X/+0, then deals damage equal to its power to another creature. It targets your creature, so Feather returns it: a scalable bite every turn (rules 1 and 4).

Cosmic Sovereign.text: Alchemy 5-mana hasty flier. As the CARRIER it conjures a random hasty creature with MV equal to its power at the start of combat on your turn, so at 8 power a free 8-drop each combat. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Thorin, Mountain-king.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Restoration Magic. OWNED. Enters and attaches ANY number of your Equipment to one creature at once, then that creature deals damage equal to its power to a creature. Instant Voltron plus removal with nine Equipment (rule 5).

Fang, Roku's Companion.text: 4/4 flier; each attack gives another LEGENDARY creature +4/+0, and Feather is legendary, as are many bodies here. Comes back once as a Spirit.

Orcish Siegemaster.text: 0/5 trample that attacks for the carrier's power as well (+X where X is your greatest power), doubling the damage of one big body; gives Krenko's Goblins trample; base 5 with Teyo. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Swords to Plowshares.text: Out by the owner's rule: it gives the opponent life (rule 4).

Dragonfly Pilot.text: Alchemy 1-drop that conjures an Equipment; low impact.

Jor Kadeen, First Goldwarden.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Giver of Runes. 2-drop trampler: +X/+X per equipped creature on attack, then draws if its power is 4+. Card advantage off the Equipment package (rules 3 and 5).

Lightning, Army of One.text: OWNED. First strike, trample, lifelink; when it hits a player, all damage to them and their permanents is doubled until your next turn. Its first-strike hit doubles the big body's regular combat damage the same turn.

Candletrap.text: 1-mana Aura: a creature can't deal combat damage, later exiled with coven. Cheap interaction, not returned by Feather.

Arni, Renowned Champion.text: Pumps itself off creatures entering; the deck doesn't make many.

Odric, Lunarch Marshal.text: At EVERY combat the team gains each keyword any of your creatures has: Boots' hexproof, Kaldra's indestructible, Embercleave's double strike and trample, across 28 creatures, re-checked each extra combat. The keywords leave with their source. Re-graded 2026-11-11 on the owner's note.

Cacophony Scamp.text: A 1-drop that proliferates or pings; nothing to build on.

Odric, Blood-Cursed.text: Blood tokens per keyword among your creatures (rummaging); a 3-mana body.

Thunderous Orator.text: Copies the big body's keywords (not its power) when it attacks: a cheap second attacker, a 2/2 double-strike flier hits for 4. Re-graded 2026-11-11 on the owner's note.

Esper Sentinel.text: 1-drop CARRIER: equipment and counters are permanent, so on the opponent's turn the tax is 4-8 and they mostly decline. About a card a turn on the short axis (rule 3), from the cheapest body to suit up. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Onward // Victory.text: Onward targets your creature and doubles its power, so Feather returns the whole card (the Aftermath half never gets used). A second Bulk Up.

Devilish Valet.text: Doubles its power for EACH other creature entering, so a Krenko wave of N Goblins doubles it N times. A combo with Krenko, a 1/3 without. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Iron Hills.text: OWNED. A tapped Boros dual; its sink counters a Dwarf (Thorin, Bruenor). The deck already runs four taplands.

Legion Leadership // Legion Stronghold.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for a Mountain. Modal: an instant that doubles a creature's power and gives first strike (aimed at your creature, so Feather returns it every turn), or a tapped Boros land. A Bulk Up that can also be a land drop (rule 1).

Two-Handed Axe // Sweeping Cleave.text: OWNED. Doubles power on EACH attack, so with the extra-combat package the second combat doubles the doubled power; Sweeping Cleave targets your creature (Feather can return the card). Re-graded 2026-11-11: the extra combats changed it.

Concerted Effort.text: Spreads the team's keywords at each upkeep; a go-wide card (rule 2).

Crater's Claws.text: X damage to any target, +2 with a 4-power creature. A one-shot (it doesn't target your creature, rule 1), but flexible reach.

Lukka, Coppercoat Outcast.text: PLANESWALKER, 5 mana: +1 impulse for creatures only, −2 polymorph, −7 each creature hits each opponent for its power. Slow for what it does here.

Éowyn, Fearless Knight.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Delney, Streetwise Lookout. Haste 3/4; enters and EXILES an opposing creature with greater power, and your legendary creatures (Feather included) gain protection from its colours. Removal on a body, 4 mana.

Shadowfax, Lord of Horses.text: Cheats a smaller creature in tapped and attacking; not a one-body card.

Heartfire Hero.text: OWNED. 1-drop that gains a counter whenever first targeted each turn (every Feather trick), and dies dealing its power to EACH opponent: Self-Destruct or Fling on it deals the power twice. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Desert Were-Worm.text: OWNED. The extra combat (attack with 12+ total power) is met by the carrier alone. Its own power is weak: ~10 Mountain-typed lands in 36 means 2-3 in play mid-game, so 4-6 power. 6 mana (rule 6). Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Loxodon Lifechanter.text: {5}{W}: +X/+X where X is your life total, at instant speed: +25/+25 at Brawl's 25 life, more with lifelink and Bre. A one-activation kill with trample or flying; 12 mana over two turns is the cost (rule 6). Re-graded 2026-11-11 on the owner's note.

Chainsaw.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Maul of the Skyclaves. OWNED. Equipment that deals 3 to a creature on entry, then grows with each creature death. Removal that also feeds Bruenor, Reyav and Akiri (rule 5).

Mephit's Enthusiasm.text: 4 damage to a creature or planeswalker; a one-shot (rule 1).

Sardian Cliffstomper.text: Needs four Mountains in play: ~10 of 36 lands are Mountains, so that is a late-game card. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

The Triumph of Anax.text: Saga: three turns of trample and +X/+0 on a creature, then a fight. Slow.

Erratic Cyclops.text: 0/8 trampler: +MV power per instant/sorcery (19 here, Feather returns the targeting ones), so it grows every turn with no equipment, and 8 toughness survives a Self-Destruct up to 7. With Teyo its base is 8 forever. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Overwhelming Victory.text: 5-mana instant: 5 to a creature, excess becomes team pump and trample. A one-shot.

Lunar Frenzy.text: {X}{R} instant: +X/+0, first strike and trample on your creature; Feather returns it, so a mana sink every turn (rule 1).

Mishra's Command.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Grand Abolisher. {X}{R} sorcery, choose two: X damage to a creature, and +X/+0 and haste on your creature. With the pump mode it targets your creature, so Feather returns it: X removal and pump every turn.

Frontline Rush.text: OWNED. Instant: two Goblins, or +X/+X on your creature where X is your creature count; the pump mode returns with Feather.

Churning Reservoir.text: Oil engine with no oil payoffs here.

Norn's Wellspring.text: Draws off creature deaths; few deaths here.

Free from Flesh.text: +2/+2 instant Feather returns, but small next to Bulk Up and Legion Leadership.

Vindictive Flamestoker.text: Gains oil per noncreature spell, then refills your hand cheaply. Feather's recasts feed it; a niche refill.

Urabrask's Forge.text: A growing hasty token every combat; a second threat stream, not the body.

Urabrask's Anointer.text: Oil-count burn on entry; no oil here.

Furnace Strider.text: Oil haste-granter; Boots, Embercleave and Fire Crystal cover haste.

Argent Dais.text: Exiles any nonland permanent, but its controller draws two: opponent-benefit removal (rule 4).

Regal Bunnicorn.text: 2-mana CARRIER: power and toughness equal your nonland permanents, and every Equipment both pumps it and raises the count. 8/8 or more mid-game for 2. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Brightmare.text: Tap a creature and gain life; filler.

Gauntlets of Light.text: Toughness assigns damage, plus pseudo-vigilance; good only on The Sentry or Luke Cage.

Thunderbond Vanguard.text: P/T equal your creature count, and every creature TOKEN enters as a copy: with Krenko each Goblin wave becomes copies of Vanguard. Strong with Krenko, narrow without. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Teyo, Aegis Adept.text: Alchemy PLANESWALKER. +1 sets a creature's base power to its toughness perpetually; on the owner's read it LOCKS the toughness at resolution, so pump toughness first (Kaldra +5/+5, Frontline Rush, Integrity) and keep it. Erratic Cyclops (0/8), Orcish Siegemaster (0/5) and Loxodon Lifechanter after an activation (+25/+25) become permanent giants. Untested in Arena. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Fling.text: With death-value carriers it doubles up: Fling an enlisted Berserker or Heartfire Hero deals the power twice, Fling Immolator banks the power on the next creature. On its own Self-Destruct is better (Feather returns it, the body survives). Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Raubahn, Bull of Ala Mhigo.text: 2-drop with ward (pay life equal to its power); each attack attaches an Equipment to an attacking creature for free. Equip mana saved every turn (rule 5).

Balduvian Berserker.text: Enlist the big body: Berserker attacks with the combined power. Blocked and killed, that power hits any target; Self-Destruct or Fling on it deals X and then the death trigger deals X again (2X). The body stays home, safe from combat tricks. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin.text: As the carrier: each attack adds a counter and Goblins equal to its power (equipment counts), and every extra combat (Seize the Day, Raph & Leo, Aurelia) makes another wave for Team Avatar and Odric. A 1/2 for 3 until equipped. Re-graded 2026-11-11 on the owner's note.

Kazuul's Fury // Kazuul's Cliffs.text: A Fling with a land face: the same death-value doubling as Fling, or a tapped Mountain when you need a land. Better than Fling here. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Origin of Thor.text: OWNED. Saga: rummage two, then counters on your creature per spell cast that turn, then that creature deals its power to EACH opponent. A Voltron finisher with card flow.

Sif's Spearmaster.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Champion of the Flame. Pings for its power each turn; a 1/4, so wants pumps it won't get over the main body.

Voldaren Thrillseeker.text: Backup 2 puts two PERMANENT counters on the big body and gives it 'sacrifice: damage equal to its power to any target' for the turn; Thrillseeker keeps that ability after. Re-graded 2026-11-11 on the owner's note.

Combustion Man.text: OWNED. As the CARRIER: each attack destroys a permanent unless they take damage equal to his power, so at 10+ power it is removal every attack, and each extra combat is another. A 4/6 body. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Go Ninja Go.text: OWNED. Damage equal to your greatest power to their creature (a one-shot), or blink your creature, which resets its counters and drops Equipment. Cut from deck 56 for that reason.

Velomachus Lorehold.text: 7-mana flier: each attack casts a free instant or sorcery from the top seven. Strong, but the top end is full (rule 6).

Molten-Core Maestro.text: 2-drop menace that takes a PERMANENT +1/+1 counter per instant/sorcery; Feather's returns make it grow every turn into a carrier, and 5-mana spells (Bionic Blow X=3) add R equal to its power. Re-graded 2026-11-11 (carrier pass).

Breaking of the Fellowship.text: Their creature hits another of theirs; one-shot removal needing two targets.

Great Train Heist.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Enter the Avatar State. OWNED. Spree instant: untap your creatures and take an EXTRA COMBAT, +1/+0 and first strike, Treasure per hit. Extra combat doubles every Sword trigger and Pain for All (cross-batch: extra combats).

Seize the Day.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Red Hulk. Sorcery: untap target creature, then an EXTRA COMBAT and main phase. Aimed at your creature it returns with Feather, so an extra combat EVERY turn, and every combat re-triggers the Swords, Akiri, Jor Kadeen and Pain for All (rule 1).

Neheb, the Eternal.text: Afflict and postcombat mana; off plan.

Éomer, Marshal of Rohan.text: Extra combat only when an attacking legend dies; awkward.

Savage Beating.text: Instant during combat: team double strike, or untap and an EXTRA COMBAT, or both entwined. Doesn't target (no Feather return); 5-7 mana.

Godo, Bandit Warlord.text: 6 mana: fetches an Equipment onto the battlefield; its extra combat only untaps Samurai.

Moraug, Fury of Akoum.text: 6 mana: a land drop in your main phase is an extra combat. Strong, but a second engine at the top of the curve.

Raph & Leo, Sibling Rivals.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Boros Reckoner. OWNED. 3 mana: each first attack untaps one or two attackers and takes an EXTRA COMBAT, every turn. The cheapest repeatable extra combat in the pile.

Response // Resurgence.text: IN 2026-11-11 (round 2) for Chandra's Ignition. Response: 2 hybrid mana for 5 damage to an attacking or blocking creature. Resurgence: 5 mana for first strike, vigilance and an extra combat. Both halves fit.

Raiyuu, Storm's Edge.text: First strike; a Samurai or Warrior attacking ALONE untaps and takes an extra combat once a turn. Raiyuu and Laelia (Warrior) qualify; it fits the attack-alone line (Team Avatar).
